Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 16mm, Weight: 1.18gms, die axis: 12
